stories.title: Ullmark leads Senators to 2-1 win over Flames
stories.summary: Linus Ullmark continued his impressive start to the season on Monday, making 34 saves to lead the Ottawa Senators to a 2-1 victory over the Calgary Flames.

stories.title: Calgary budget talks begin as hundreds sign up for public hearing
stories.summary: Calgary has proposed a 15 per cent property tax increase for 2027, which is expected to cost in an extra $53 monthly when combined with waste, recycling and water fee increases.

stories.title: Lions coach Pierce signs extension through 2029
Canada Olympic Park gets snow-making exemption from Calgary water restrictions
stories.summary: Calgary has granted a special exemption to allow snow-making at Canada Olympic Park while the city remains under water restrictions.

stories.title: Alberta to begin search for new privacy commissioner as UCP deny contract renewal
stories.summary: Privacy commissioner Diane McLeod applied to renew her contract, but a legislature committee voted instead to begin a search for a replacement ahead of her term coming to an end.

stories.title: New act allows Alberta step in on natural gas pipelines — if private sector falls short
stories.summary: The proposed Natural Gas Infrastructure Act does not in itself create new Crown entities to plan or invest in pipelines — but gives the province the ability to do so, if necessary.

stories.title: Alberta proposes new limits, penalties for provincial voter list after privacy breach
stories.summary: The bill comes amid an investigation into a major privacy breach this year involving a separatist group believed to have inappropriately obtained and used a copy of the voter list.

stories.title: Premiers Ford, Smith say interprovincial trade remains complicated despite efforts
stories.summary: Ford says Ontario is the only province that eradicated every trade exemption, but he agrees that internal free trade has been challenging to implement.

stories.title: Edmonton corn maze stabbing suspect found not criminally responsible of murder
stories.summary: Michael Ferzli, who was on trial for murder in the August 2024 corn maze stabbing of Joseph Farnsworth, was found not criminally responsible due to having schizophrenia.

stories.title: 3 Calgary police officers charged with manslaughter in death of Alberta cowboy Jon Wells
stories.summary: Well-known Indigenous rodeo champion Jon Wells, 42, died in police custody following a confrontation at the Carriage House hotel in south Calgary on Sept. 17, 2024.
